description: This file is a shell script designed to run tests related to Git receive input limits and repository configurations. It sets up test repositories, modifies configurations, and validates behavior for different limit scenarios.

methods.name: validate_store_type
methods.description: Validates the current store type by inspecting the output of 'git count-objects -v' inside the destination repository.

methods.name: test_pack_input_limit
methods.description: Runs a series of tests to verify behavior under different unpack limits and input size configurations in a Git repository.
